title: Plaid adapter configuration
description: Per-Item configuration consumed by packs/adapters/financial/plaid/adapter.py at start(). Secret references use the 1Password 'op://<vault>/<item>/<field>' pattern per ADMINISTRATEME_BUILD.md §L1; raw secrets are a constitutional violation. sensitivity_floor is a hardcoded const at the pack level per SYSTEM_INVARIANTS.md §6 invariant 10 — any config that tries to lower it to 'normal' is rejected by JSON-schema validation before the loader runs.

item_access_token_ref.description: 1Password reference to the long-lived Plaid Item access token (POST /item/public_token/exchange result). NEVER the token value itself.

plaid_client_id_ref.description: 1Password reference to the Plaid API client_id.

plaid_secret_ref.description: 1Password reference to the Plaid API secret.

webhook_route.description: HTTP route the adapter registers for Plaid webhook delivery (e.g. '/webhooks/plaid'). The adapter supervisor mounts the route at startup.

member_id.description: Household member who owns this Plaid Item. Stamped onto every money_flow.plaid_synced event so downstream consumers can owner-scope correctly.

plaid_item_id.description: Plaid's stable Item identifier. The cursor is persisted per (member_id, plaid_item_id) tuple per BUILD.md PLAID DETAILED SPEC §'Sync cursor'.

institution_id.description: Plaid institution_id (e.g. 'ins_109508'). Used to fetch institution health via /institutions/status/get.

sensitivity_floor.description: Hardcoded constant per SYSTEM_INVARIANTS.md §6 invariant 10 — financial adapters cannot be downgraded to 'normal'. JSON-schema validation rejects any other value.

dedupe_window_minutes.description: Adapter-side dedupe window for inbound webhook duplicates (Plaid may re-deliver). Defaults to 90 minutes.

backstop_poll_interval_s.description: Provider-watcher recovery interval in seconds. Webhooks remain primary.
